everything-bagels.name: everything bagels, baked
everything-bagels.traits: their pale speckled bagel dough, baked golden, irregular hand-made rounds (never rounder or more evenly seeded than in the photo), thickly covered in their everything topping of sesame, poppy, dried onion and garlic.
everything-bagels.source: their own photo (blueprint american-crust-moving.md:54); traits and the 'too round, too even' mistake from scrollcraft/builds/american-crust/gen/film-brief.md:14-15

pizza-dough-tub.name: Pizza Dough tub
pizza-dough-tub.traits: a round white plastic tub of pale pizza dough with the black PIZZA DOUGH label and their logo on the lid. The label's small print is never redrawn by the model: cut their real label from the photo and lay it on in code.
pizza-dough-tub.source: their flyer photo (film-brief.md:6-7); the label was misread three times (50GRAM, 60GRAM, a wrong phone number), film-brief.md:9
